confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Norwegian and Bergen price levels for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are more reliable than drinks and hotel rooms, which vary widely by season and location. Norway is high-cost, so the figures are set above typical Western European city levels. FX: the 0.6955 figure came from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA page, not from a direct read of the RBA table. Other sources quoted different rates for nearby dates (0.6979 on 9 October, 0.7002 on 14 October), so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Norwegian price levels, using Oslo and other mid-sized Norwegian tourist cities as the reference, adjusted for Bergen's tourist season and typical hostel and hotel supply.
